title: The Infinity Saga
intro: [excited] Welcome to Disney Jeopardy! Tonight we collect six stones, survive one snap, and travel through twenty-three movies. [dramatically] Fate, it seems, is not without a sense of irony.

art.prompt: Six glowing colored gemstones orbiting a purple planet in deep space, golden stardust swirling around them, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

categories.title: Stone Cold
categories.intro: Six little rocks, one very big problem. Name the Infinity Stone for each clue. [chuckles] Snap to it.

art.prompt: A velvet-lined treasure case holding six empty glowing slots under museum lights, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: The glowing blue Tesseract was hiding this Infinity Stone.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Space Stone! Blue cube, big trouble.

clues.clue: Vision's life is powered by this stone set in his forehead.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Mind Stone! [warmly] A synthezoid with a heart of gold. Well, yellow.

clues.clue: Doctor Strange keeps this stone inside the Eye of Agamotto.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Time Stone! Dormammu, I've come to bargain.

clues.clue: In Thor: The Dark World, the swirling Aether turns out to be this stone.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Reality Stone! [dramatically] Red, gooey and very bad for Jane.

clues.clue: Thanos claims the Soul Stone on this grim planet, at a terrible cost.
clues.reveal: [softly] The correct answer is Vormir. A soul for a soul. Chet needs a moment.

categories.title: Phase One-derful
categories.intro: Way back to Phase One, when the Avengers were just getting started. [chuckles] Simpler times.

art.prompt: A dusty top-secret filing cabinet drawer full of folders stamped with an eagle silhouette, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: In Captain America: The First Avenger, Steve battles this crimson-faced HYDRA leader.
clues.reveal: [dramatically] The correct answer is the Red Skull! Not a skincare success story.

clues.clue: Tony Stark's loyal assistant, who later runs his company, is this woman.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pepper Potts! [excited] The real boss of Stark Industries.

clues.clue: In The Incredible Hulk, soldier Emil Blonsky transforms into this monster.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Abomination! He comes back years later in She-Hulk, very calm.

clues.clue: In the first Thor movie, the banished god crash-lands in this U.S. state.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is New Mexico! [laughs] He walked into a pet store asking for a horse.

clues.clue: Agent Coulson, the S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who connected Phase One, has this first name.
clues.reveal: [warmly] The correct answer is Phil! Agent Coulson, collector of vintage trading cards.

categories.title: Infinity War Room
categories.intro: Now the big two: Infinity War and Endgame. [dramatically] Whatever it takes.

art.prompt: A war room table with a glowing holographic map of the galaxy and empty chairs around it, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Thanos comes from this ruined moon-sized world.
clues.reveal: [dramatically] The correct answer is Titan! Lovely place, if you like rubble.

clues.clue: In Avengers: Endgame, the heroes travel through time by way of this tiny realm.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Quantum Realm! A sandwich van saved the universe.

clues.clue: Thor forges this new axe at Nidavellir in Infinity War.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Stormbreaker! [excited] Bring me Thanos!

clues.clue: Thanos' fearsome adopted children are known by this group name.
clues.reveal: [dramatically] The correct answer is the Black Order! Terrible family reunions.

clues.clue: This many years pass between the Snap and the Avengers' time heist in Endgame.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is five years! [chuckles] Long enough for Scott to miss a lot.

categories.title: Gem Gallery
categories.intro: Picture category! Each image shows a famous object from the Infinity Saga. Tell me what I'm asking for.

art.prompt: A dim museum vault with glass display cases on pedestals, each case glowing a different color, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: This glowing object carries the Space Stone. Name it. Pictured: a glowing translucent blue cube crackling with energy.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Tesseract! Handle with oven mitts.

media.prompt: A glowing translucent blue cube crackling with energy, floating above a metal laboratory pedestal, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Which trickster swung this staff in The Avengers? Pictured: an ornate golden scepter with a curved blade and a glowing blue gem at its tip.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Loki! [dramatically] Kneel before him. Or don't.

media.prompt: An ornate golden scepter with a curved blade and a glowing blue gem at its tip, lying on a marble floor, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Name this mystical amulet. Pictured: a heavy golden eye-shaped amulet on a chain.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Eye of Agamotto! It holds the Time Stone and looks fabulous.

media.prompt: A heavy golden eye-shaped amulet on a chain, glowing green from within, resting on an old spellbook, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Star-Lord swipes this metal sphere in Guardians of the Galaxy. Which Infinity Stone hides inside? Pictured: a battered silver metal orb about the size of a softball.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Power Stone! [laughs] And he danced the whole time.

media.prompt: A battered silver metal orb about the size of a softball, sitting in a dusty alien temple with a beam of light on it, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: This swirling crimson substance from Thor: The Dark World is called this. Pictured: swirling dark red liquid smoke twisting through the air inside an ancient stone chamber.
clues.reveal: [dramatically] The correct answer is the Aether! Dark Elves, darker plot.

media.prompt: Swirling dark red liquid smoke twisting through the air inside an ancient stone chamber, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

categories.title: Quantum Vacation
categories.intro: To the parks and the high seas! These Infinity Saga heroes are ready for vacation. [excited] Sunscreen and shields.

art.prompt: A sleek cruise ship sailing at sunset past a glowing hero-themed theme park skyline, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Doctor Strange performs mystic arts at this temple-like spot in Avengers Campus.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Ancient Sanctum! Sparks, spells and a touch of drama.

clues.clue: The queue for EPCOT's Cosmic Rewind is a gallery celebrating this planet, home of the Nova Corps.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Xandar! [excited] The Wonders of Xandar pavilion, very educational.

clues.clue: Avengers Campus opened at Disney California Adventure in this year.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is 2021! Recruits finally reported for duty.

clues.clue: This Marvel-themed restaurant on the Disney Wish lets diners join a hero mission.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Worlds of Marvel! [chuckles] Dinner and a battle.

clues.clue: At Worlds of Marvel, the dinner show is called Avengers: this Encounter.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Quantum Encounter! Ant-Man shrinks, the dessert doesn't.
